rules.description: Variadic parameters are ignored before annotation or provider checks.
Positional-only parameters fail before annotation or provider checks.

requires.message: autowire does not support positional-only parameter '{name}'

rules.description: Ordinary positional-or-keyword and keyword-only parameters proceed to annotation checks.
An annotated parameter attempts one provider lookup, even with a default.
An unannotated parameter with a default is omitted from the injection plan.
An unannotated required parameter fails without a lookup.

requires.message: autowire requires a type annotation for parameter '{name}'

rules.description: An attempted lookup failure propagates before provider availability is used.
A default cannot turn a failed lookup into fallback.
A lookup that returns allows the provider decision.
A registered annotated dependency is appended to the plan in parameter order.
An available injection takes precedence over the parameter's default.
An unavailable annotated dependency uses the default without injection.
An unavailable required annotated dependency raises missing_key.

requires.message: No provider registered for autowired dependency '{name}'
